about: What stands printed beside each form field of this form: taken from the definition the form is built from (tools/forms/austrittsmeldung.js). Applied by tools/correct.js. Every question is written by hand (11 October 2026): the model's questions were read after every capture, they pointed at the right place each time, and two that were worded alike were dropped by the check in two captures of three, and the sheet of the walk-through should ask the same words every time. The kinds of four fields are named here as the model proposed them in every capture (an identifier, a postcode, a telephone number, an e-mail address): should a later capture propose another, these stand.
